name: home
description: Represents home, dashboard, or primary landing navigation. On hover or trigger, a roof stroke draws and settles into place over the house outline while a doorway block slides down into the floor to open the home entrance (~450ms).

animation.description: Multi-layer sequence: a roof stroke pathLength 0→1 draws down (y -1.5→0, 0.3s) before fading out, while a doorway block rect (scaleY 1→0, 0.2s, 0.15s delay) shrinks into the floor to reveal the entrance cutout. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: Main navigation entry point. Ensure aria-label or visible label text indicates current page state when active.
